method: index_profile in a fresh process/provider; no GPU or detail cache; recently accessed bundles; OS cache uncontrolled. These are observations, not release-gate percentiles.
reference_machine: Apple M5,16 GiB,macOS26.6.2,Rust1.96.0; optimized development profile

samples.notes: Fresh provider/process. First phase includes opening, record reads, JSON decode, record validation and incremental metadata indexing. Second phase starts at the first full-byte progress callback and includes final ownership/lens/endpoint validation/indexes, file fingerprint check and provider construction. Total is measured before querying manifest/stats or writing this report. OS cache state is not controlled. No scene, source-code dereference, GPU work or entity detail loading. Timings are observations, not work budgets or correctness gates; peak RSS must be joined from an external process measurement.
samples.wrapper_failure: The index example produced its report; sandboxed /usr/bin/time -l then failed to read sysctl kern.clockrate. No usable resource counters from this run.
